initial_documentation_gaps: Admission.weight_steps is required by this acceptance assignment, but its name and meaning do not appear in the permitted public onboarding guides.

The guides name custom proposer learn/propose methods without signatures, feedback fields, or the resident reward borrow/host-transfer methods. A custom MiningDriver learning callback cannot be implemented from them alone.

ExecutionFeedback is described semantically without its concrete field names/shapes. This program reacts to the documented event.owner_quantity and counts feedback callbacks without guessing feedback record attributes.

The guides do not show a complete resident result stream-readiness contract. This single-device client explicitly synchronizes CUDA before consuming borrowed returns, and uses context.stream for every program tensor operation.
A successful admission is data-dependent. A two-day smoke can validate evaluation and a direct commit attempt without guaranteeing portfolio growth.
independent_agent.documentation_resolution: R5 guides now document trial sizing, producer feedback contracts, execution columns and stream readiness

evidence_scope: Full raw archive retained locally in var/runs
